description:
Build `target_db` from `source_copy_db` (made by data_pump_source) - IN THE BACKGROUND
    (tens of minutes for a large database); poll data_pump_status.

    With `template_db` the target is first RE-CREATED from the template (a fresh database of the
    new major with the right modules + languages): dropdb --force (a running service may hold it)
    + createdb -T + the template filestore. Re-creating is refused for a database the pump did not
    build that holds business data (force=true overrides). Then: map, schema, leaves, copy, m2m,
    xmlid, post (stages='all') -> `custom_modules` installed -> translations -> second pass for
    the custom modules' data -> (mode='test', neutralize=true) `odoo neutralize` + the pump's own
    safety stage. mode='golive' builds WITHOUT neutralisation (secrets/crons then come from
    data_pump_golive). `stages` may run single stages again (e.g. 'langs' on the template,
    'continuity', 'post'). `options` = client decisions (skip_models, skip_by_name, param_keep,
    param_ids, currency_shift...), echoed in the report. The source copy is only read.
    `restart_service=false` skips the final restart of the target service - use it when that service
    serves OTHER databases people are working in (a shared test stack); the build itself runs in
    `odoo shell` and does not need the restart.
name: data_pump_run
